newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahraini emir meets Argentina's Menem.
newsitem.headline: Bahraini emir meets Argentina's Menem.

text.p: Bahrain's Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa on Sunday held talks with visiting Argentine President Carlos Menem on ways of boosting trade, the official Gulf News Agency reported.
It said both leaders called for stronger economic and trade ties.
The Argentine president was due to kick off a three-stop Southeast Asian tour in Vietnam late on Sunday, the first known visit to the communist country by a South American head of state.
Menem arrived in Bahrain on Saturday.
